title: Residual momentum — original vs optimized V2 vs confluence boost

method.optimized_v2: Locked confidence sizing: mild shrink-to-equal + cash buffer when mean confidence is weak.
method.boost: At each rebalance, if a selected name clears ≥2 of the curated stack (n03_rsi_sweet, n04_breakout20, n05_accel, n06_reclaim200), its sleeve weight is ×1.5, then the sleeve is renormalized. Below, each confluence is also tested alone at ×1.5.

name_confluence_catalog.name: RS + 50dma
name_confluence_catalog.thesis: Beating SPY over 21d while price holds above its 50dma.

name_confluence_catalog.name: RSI sweet spot
name_confluence_catalog.thesis: 14d RSI between 45 and 65 — momentum without euphoria.

name_confluence_catalog.name: Momentum accel
name_confluence_catalog.thesis: 21d return stronger than one-third of 63d return (acceleration).

name_confluence_catalog.name: Fresh 200dma reclaim
name_confluence_catalog.thesis: Above 200dma now, but traded below it sometime in the prior 63d.

name_confluence_catalog.name: Vol contraction
name_confluence_catalog.thesis: 21d realized vol below 63d vol — quieter backdrop for trend.

core_books.label: Original Resid Mom (Tech 80%)
core_books.thesis: Equal-weight within sleeves. The established baseline.

core_books.label: Optimized V2 (confidence sizing)
core_books.thesis: Mild shrink-to-equal + confidence cash buffer (locked size cfg).

core_books.label: Original + stacked confluence ×1.5
core_books.thesis: Same names as original; if a name clears ≥2 of [RSI sweet spot, 20d breakout, Momentum accel, Fresh 200dma reclaim], size ×1.5 then renormalize sleeve.

core_books.label: Optimized V2 + stacked confluence ×1.5
core_books.thesis: V2 confidence sizing, then ×1.5 when ≥2 curated stack signals fire.

confluence_tests.label: ×1.5 when Vol contraction
confluence_tests.thesis: 21d realized vol below 63d vol — quieter backdrop for trend.

confluence_tests.label: ×1.5 when RSI sweet spot
confluence_tests.thesis: 14d RSI between 45 and 65 — momentum without euphoria.

confluence_tests.label: ×1.5 when Fresh 200dma reclaim
confluence_tests.thesis: Above 200dma now, but traded below it sometime in the prior 63d.

confluence_tests.label: ×1.5 when RS + 50dma
confluence_tests.thesis: Beating SPY over 21d while price holds above its 50dma.

confluence_tests.label: ×1.5 when Momentum accel
confluence_tests.thesis: 21d return stronger than one-third of 63d return (acceleration).

warnings: Long-only residual momentum, Tech 80% sleeve — no shorts.
Confluence boost = ×1.5 when ≥2 curated stack signals fire (n03_rsi_sweet, n04_breakout20, n05_accel, n06_reclaim200); single-signal tables test each confluence alone.
Signals are lag-1 (prior close) to avoid look-ahead.
Hard MaxDD gate in scores: reject if |MaxDD| > 35%.
